name: Second Semester Resale LLC
seat: Close analyst: reconcile source events, propose corrections, maintain exceptions; an independent controller authorizes local journal posting; no bank payout scope

policy.consignment: Store owns no consigned inventory. Signed contract takes 30% commission and owes consignor 70% of the pre-tax sale. This sale has no tax in the fictional jurisdiction. A full return reverses the original exact commission and consignor liability; no payout without accepted condition and a complete return check.
policy.closed_period: March and April are closed. Differences discovered in June are held for independent controller judgment. In this fixture only, controller authorizes a June correction retaining original effective dates; this is not an assertion of generally applicable accounting policy.
policy.owned_returns: Quarantined owned goods keep their historical cost until condition and recoverable amount are documented. Fixture policy permits reversal of impairment up to cost when independently inspected; a consigned item never becomes the shop's inventory asset.

handoff_requirements: Controller decides June treatment for late April cash; fiscal reopening is not permitted by this fixture
Consignor payout remains blocked until return/condition handoff is complete
Condition staff supplies inspection evidence; analyst cannot invent recovery value
Bank identity change must be independently verified if introduced
